contributions.statement: A budgeted, sanitized verifier-feedback tool (at most 3 calls after edit+compile) added value mainly when coupled with evolving the skill file, at a matched evolution budget.
contributions.evidence: §4.2-4.3: C3 vs C4 at matched EA budget (3 to 6 of 8 tasks with at least one pass), 640 rollouts per configuration, skills tuned and scored on the same 8 Verilog tasks.

reason: Test-time search over a skill file on the evaluation tasks themselves, with 20x baseline compute and no held-out split. A Java team writing shared skills cannot act on it.
